E0938

`#Memo` requires a pure function (D-MEMO1=A)

What

`#Memo` requires a pure function (D-MEMO1=A)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0938

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0938: tests/ui/memo_impure_e0938.stderr.

Error [E0938]: `#Memo` requires a pure function
  --> tests/ui/memo_impure_e0938.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Memo fn impure() Int -> 1
    | ^^^^^
 Why: memoization reuses a completed result, so the function must have the empty effect row
 Fix: declare the function with `-[]>` and keep `#Memo`
